environment.description: EC2 instance (m5.large) running in VPC subnet-0a1b2c3d with IAM instance profile 'DocumentServiceRole' that has s3:GetObject and s3:ListBucket on arn:aws:s3:::company-documents-prod/*. Instance connects to S3 via public internet through NAT gateway. No VPC endpoint configured. The S3 bucket contains sensitive data under prefixes like 'internal/', 'secrets/', 'admin-config/' in addition to the allowed prefixes.

config.iam_policy: s3:GetObject, s3:ListBucket on arn:aws:s3:::company-documents-prod and arn:aws:s3:::company-documents-prod/*
config.network: NAT gateway to public internet, no VPC endpoint
